card.name: Overdose section opening phrases
card.fires_on: The word right after a statement about overdose, such as 'been' in 'have not been reported' or 'Experience' opening an OVERDOSAGE section. Also 'in' after 'rates observed' in adverse reaction text.

modes.label: Overdose reports
modes.description: 'been' in 'no cases of overdosage have been reported' within an overdosage section.
modes.example: No cases of micafungin for injection overdosage have<< been>> reported.

modes.label: Section opener
modes.description: 'Experience' as the first word after the OVERDOSAGE heading.
modes.example: 10 OVERDOSAGE<< Experience>> with bosutinib overdose in clinical

modes.label: Trial rate wording
modes.description: 'in' after 'rates observed' in the clinical trials experience paragraph.
modes.example: adverse reaction rates observed<< in>> the clinical trials

card.plain: It fires on stock wording in overdose and adverse-reaction sections, just before phrases like 'been reported' or 'with doses'.
